name: Muang Ake Pet Hospital Pattaya
addressFull: 44/57 Moo 11, Sukhumvit Road, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
afterHours: The official group emergency centre serves the Pattaya branch 24 hours.

emergency.notes: The official emergency-centre page names the Pattaya branch and states that its 24-hour emergency and surgical centre is supervised by veterinarians and professional nurses. Current Google Maps and Petmap listings corroborate round-the-clock opening. The branch publishes no separate after-hours number, surcharge, wait time, or explicit first-time-client policy.

petTravel.notes: Official group pages advertise international health certificates, microchipping, and rabies-titre testing with certificates for travel; the service pages list the Pattaya branch phone. The microchip page prints 'ISO 11758', so ISO 11784/11785 compliance is not safely established. DLD export-permit processing, a DLD licence number, and the destination laboratory were not published.

complaints: mixed comments about communication and cost transparency
